name: @custom-video-processing-engine/analytics-telemetry-platform
description: Predictive Analytics & Telemetry Lake microservice: high-throughput QoE beacon ingestion (Kafka/Redpanda -> ClickHouse), QoE metric computation, hardware decoder anomaly detection with auto-remediation, encoding A/B test evaluation with live rollback automation, real-time CCU aggregation, QoE/churn correlation analysis, and micro-session distributed tracing (Redis-backed for multi-replica deployments).
